auditor: independent AI auditor (did not write the paper); a fresh one for every round

audits.summary: All 252 registry rows have commands, hashed logs and matching metrics; three main-group runs re-executed bit-identically, and every number and p-value in the paper recomputes from the registry. The code implements the described estimators with matched budgets and no leakage, and the paper reports its mixed/negative result and limitations honestly. Only minor issues remain: two foundational works uncited, one overclaimed mechanism sentence, a post hoc ablation not flagged, and presentation glitches.

findings.issue: van Hasselt (2010) Double Q-learning and Sutton & Barto, the central method and benchmark, are named in text but not in the reference list.
findings.fix: Add both to refs.bib (NeurIPS 2010 proceedings entry; the textbook) and cite them.

findings.issue: Uncited claim that the standard tabular evidence is a single small MDP; van Hasselt 2010, Zhang 2017 and Lan 2020, as recalled by the auditor (not fetched), include other tabular experiments.
findings.fix: Soften the sentence and cite the tabular experiments in those papers.

findings.issue: States that Double's cost is 'thus a cost of reaching the true values from a bad initialisation, not a property of the steady state'; one 1,000-episode warm-start ablation does not establish this and it contradicts the paper's own 'none of them is a proof of mechanism'.
findings.fix: Reword to 'consistent with' and drop the steady-state assertion.

findings.issue: Zero initialisation is offered as the likely reason both Q-biases are positive, but the warm-start run shows Q-learning's Q-bias unchanged (0.0748 vs 0.0745); only Double's drops.
findings.fix: Attribute the initialisation effect to Double only and describe Q-learning's bias as persisting under warm start.

findings.issue: The 20 trap-MDP warm-start runs were added after the main results (jobs_extra.txt, commit 18990bd) but are presented as 'the clean version of H1' without being flagged as post hoc.
findings.fix: State in the setup that the trap-MDP warm-start runs were added after seeing the main results.

findings.where: paper Tables I and II (generated/main.tex, abl_warm.tex)
findings.issue: Down-arrows and bold/underline on signed bias columns mark the most negative bias as best; disclaimed only in the results text.
findings.fix: Remove the marks on signed columns or repeat the disclaimer in the captions.

findings.issue: The Weighted Double target overflows the column and is cut off in the PDF.
findings.fix: Break the equation over two lines.

findings.issue: Sweep tables report means only, with no spread.
findings.fix: Add the standard deviation over seeds or state its bound in the caption.

findings.issue: Auto-generated ablation table says 'missing / Matters? NO' for every ablation, contradicting the paper's ablation findings.
findings.fix: Regenerate with ablation deltas wired in, or annotate that the table is not populated.

pre_submission_reviews.what: Before submission the venue's own review panel (same reviewers, rubric and decision rule as the official round; no area chair) read the study. A study the panel would not accept gets up to two improve rounds, each audited again, and is held back (not submitted) if the panel still would not accept. Papers submitted before 2026-10-03 had no such step.
